summary: Assist to Custer County with one Tier 3 rescue tech for an injured 18-year-old man in the Spread Eagle Peak area Update 2026-09-23: Custer SAR identifies this as the 2022-05-13 rescue of four Air Force Academy cadets near Spread Eagle Peak: one fell ~200 ft from a ridge (hoisted by COARNG UH-60 with Colorado Hoist Rescue Team techs, flown to Level 1 Trauma Center, Colorado Springs); the other three were located via SMS locators and hiked out with ground teams.
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team, Custer County SAR
notes: Injury mechanism not stated in log; ART mission 2022-027.
